result.lowerIsBetter: Lower is better: the closest class wins.

confidence.svm: SVM: (score of the winner − score of the runner-up) ÷ max(1, |score of the winner|), clipped to 0–1.
confidence.knn: KNN: 1 − distance of the winner ÷ distance of the runner-up (closest training image of each class).
confidence.random_forest: Random Forest: the largest averaged tree probability.
confidence.generic: Confidence of the winning class, from the model's decision values.
confidence.notComparable: Confidences are not comparable across algorithms.

scoreKind.svm_ovr_score: One-vs-rest score: votes plus confidence (largest wins).

params.lockedHelp: Defined by training. Change it in config.py and run make run.

size.label: Localization size
size.help: Resolution used to locate the bottle. It must match the stored background. The foreground threshold is found per image (Otsu's method).

close_size.label: Closing size
close_size.help: Diameter of the morphological closing of the foreground mask. The bottle is transparent, so its mask has holes; closing joins them.

open_size.label: Opening size
open_size.help: Diameter of the morphological opening applied after the closing. It removes thin lines and specks.

profile_smoothing.label: Profile smoothing
profile_smoothing.help: Width of the moving average applied to the column profile of the mask before finding the bottle columns.

column_fraction.label: Column fraction
column_fraction.help: The bottle is searched in the columns around the peak of the column profile that stay above this fraction of the peak; its centre is the middle of that run.

bottle_width.label: Bottle width
bottle_width.help: Width of the bottle box, as a fraction of the image width, centred on the bottle found in the column profile.

top_fraction.label: Top fraction
top_fraction.help: Inside those columns, the top of the bottle is the first row that reaches this fraction of the densest row.

row_fraction.label: Bottom fraction
row_fraction.help: Inside those columns, the bottom of the bottle is the last row that reaches this fraction of the densest row.

enabled.label: Normalize lighting
enabled.help: Rescale each channel so the reference patch matches the background.

reference_patch.label: Reference patch
reference_patch.help: Wall region never covered by a bottle. Drag it on the preview.

crop_size.label: Bottle resize
crop_size.help: Size the detected bottle box is resized to before HOG and LBP. The automatic regions are slices of it.

cap.label: Cap band
cap.help: Vertical band of the cap ROI inside the detected bottle box (0% = top of the bottle, 100% = bottom). Drag its edges on the preview.

label.label: Label band
label.help: Vertical band of the label ROI inside the detected bottle box (0% = top of the bottle, 100% = bottom). Drag its edges on the preview.

body.label: Body band
body.help: Vertical band of the body ROI inside the detected bottle box (0% = top of the bottle, 100% = bottom). Drag its edges on the preview.

cap_size.label: Cap resize
cap_size.help: Size the cap ROI is resized to before HOG.

label_size.label: Label resize
label_size.help: Size the label ROI is resized to before HOG.

body_size.label: Body resize
body_size.help: Size the body ROI is resized to before HOG.

bands.label: Learned bands
bands.help: Vertical bands of the three automatic regions inside the bottle box, learned from the training images. They are never edited: they come from training, like the background.

cell_cap.label: Cap cell
cell_cap.help: HOG cell size of the cap ROI.

cell_label.label: Label cell
cell_label.help: HOG cell size of the label ROI.

cell_body.label: Body cell
cell_body.help: HOG cell size of the body ROI.

cell_auto.label: Automatic regions cell
cell_auto.help: HOG cell size shared by the three automatic regions.

cell_bottle.label: Bottle cell
cell_bottle.help: HOG cell size of the whole bottle.

points.label: LBP points
points.help: Neighbors compared with each pixel by the LBP operator.

radius.label: LBP radius
radius.help: Radius, in pixels, of the circle of LBP neighbors.

cell_cap.label: Cap cell
cell_cap.help: LBP cell size of the cap ROI.

cell_label.label: Label cell
cell_label.help: LBP cell size of the label ROI.

cell_body.label: Body cell
cell_body.help: LBP cell size of the body ROI.

cell_auto.label: Automatic regions cell
cell_auto.help: LBP cell size shared by the three automatic regions.

cell_bottle.label: Bottle cell
cell_bottle.help: LBP cell size of the whole bottle.

hsv_bins.label: HSV histogram bins
hsv_bins.help: Histogram bins of the H, S and V channels.

groups.label: Feature groups
groups.help: Feature groups concatenated into the vector used by the model (one descriptor per model).

reject_classes.label: Classes that reject
reject_classes.help: A prediction of any of these classes gives REJECT.

min_confidence.label: Minimum confidence
min_confidence.help: Below this confidence the verdict becomes the low-confidence verdict.

low_confidence_verdict.label: Low-confidence verdict
low_confidence_verdict.help: Verdict used when the confidence is below the minimum. REVIEW is shown in amber.

debug.baseProfile: with the parameters and background of
debug.baseProfileHelp: The steps below do not depend on the classifier. Profiles trained in the same run share these parameters and this background, so the result is the same for all of them; a profile that differs is flagged in its panel.

empty.title: Choose an image to debug
empty.body: Upload a file, drop it here or pick a dataset sample. Every step is shown, from the background difference to the bottle box and the regions; then select the profiles to compare. Choosing another image starts over.

adjust.help: Temporary adjustments: they apply to the steps below and to every selected profile, only on this screen. No profile is changed.

original.title: Original image
original.summary: The photo is a matrix of numbers: rows × columns × 3 channels (blue, green, red), each from 0 to 255.

background.title: Background model
background.summary: The empty scene: per-pixel median of 200 training images. It is saved inside the trained model.
background.caption: Background used for the subtraction

normalization.title: Lighting normalization
normalization.summary: The wall patch is measured in the image and in the background; each channel is multiplied by the gain that makes them equal.
normalization.disabled: Disabled for this profile: the image goes on unchanged.
normalization.patchAfter: The same 4×4 pixels after the gain

difference.title: Difference to the background
difference.summary: |image − background| added over B, G and R for each pixel; Otsu's method chooses the threshold of this image.

mask.title: Foreground mask
mask.summary: Pixels above the threshold; the closing joins the holes of the transparent bottle and the opening removes thin lines.

locate.title: Bottle box
locate.summary: Columns: white pixels per column (smoothed); the box spans the run around the peak that stays above the fraction. Rows: inside those columns, from the first to the last row above the fraction of the densest row.
locate.empty: The mask is empty: the box is the whole image.
locate.plot: Mask with the column profile above, the row profile beside it and the measured box
locate.columns: white pixels per column (gray: before smoothing)
locate.xRange: Columns of the bottle in the mask ({size})

regions.title: Regions
regions.summary: Bands of the detected box (0 = top, 1 = bottom). Each crop is later resized to its fixed size.
regions.adhoc: Box (dashed) and the 3 ad hoc ROIs
regions.auto: Box (dashed) and the automatic regions learned in training
regions.noAuto: This profile has no automatic regions.

profiles.title: Results per profile
profiles.help: Add, remove or swap profiles at any time: the image stays loaded and each profile is computed once.

profile.differentPreprocessing: This profile uses another preprocessing (parameters or background) than the steps shown above.
profile.showItsPreprocessing: Show the steps of this profile
profile.vectorHelp: {n} values, in the order the classifier receives them; the colours mark the {groups, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}}.
profile.scaledHelp: After the model's StandardScaler (what the classifier compares): 0 is the training mean.

group.lbpCodes: LBP code of each pixel, with the cells
